New state refs require real telemetry producers before allowlisting. Create ch13 index before invoking existing generators, then synchronize imports/views; do not open generator edits by default. Keep public release ch4-arrival and protected later W recurrence. Exactly four formal scene beats: ch13-home, ch13-return, ch13-survey, ch13-common.
